subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept this waited A2A artifact-suppression boundary for message-tool mirror and inter-session transcript rows before merge?
rationale: The patch looks correct and well-proven, but it intentionally changes message-delivery eligibility in a channel-visible A2A path that CI cannot fully settle for every real channel history.

options.title: Accept The Boundary
options.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the fix is narrow and the Gateway/QA proof targets the duplicate visible-message failure mode.

options.title: Require Live Channel Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live WhatsApp or equivalent channel transcript if deterministic qa-channel proof is not enough.

options.title: Defer To A2A Coordination
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the mirror, reverse-send, and compaction duplicate fixes accepted under one coordinated A2A delivery decision.

recommendation.title: Accept The Boundary
recommendation.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the fix is narrow and the Gateway/QA proof targets the duplicate visible-message failure mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent delivery-mirror provenance work makes Vincent the closest routing candidate for accepting the transcript-artifact boundary.
